device.description: dual 8-bit voltage-output DAC with internal programmable reference, 3-wire SPI/TMS320 serial interface, double-buffered DAC B, programmable settling time and power down

registers.name: LATCHA
registers.note: DAC A latch (no double buffer: also its input register); power-on reset clears the latches to all zero

registers.name: BUFFER
registers.note: BUFFER latch, the input register of DAC B; power-on zero

registers.name: LATCHB
registers.note: DAC B latch; loaded from the serial word (R1 R0 = 00) or from BUFFER (R1 R0 = 10)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: SPD (D14, 1 = fast) and PWR (D13, 1 = power down) of the last word; REF1 REF0 (D1 D0 of a control-register word: 00/11 external, 01 1.024 V, 10 2.048 V internal); power-on all zero

commands.name: Write DAC A, update DAC B from BUFFER (R1 R0 = 10)
commands.note: D15 R1, D14 SPD, D13 PWR, D12 R0, data MSB first; DAC A latch written, DAC B updated with the BUFFER content

commands.name: Write DAC B and BUFFER (R1 R0 = 00)
commands.note: the data goes to BUFFER and DAC B

commands.name: Write BUFFER (R1 R0 = 01)
commands.note: BUFFER only; DAC A and B unchanged

commands.name: Write control register (R1 R0 = 11)
commands.note: D1 D0 = REF1 REF0; D11-D2 don't care

protocol.note: CS falling starts the frame; DIN sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK high at CS falling, Figure 1 -> mode 2); after 16 bits the shift register moves to the latches the R1/R0 bits select

device.note: tlv5626.pdf (SLAS236A) p.1 (D pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.6 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.10 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.11 (data format, register-select bits, DAC data bits D11-D4), p.12 (control register REF1/REF0, examples)

pages: (SLAS236A) p.1 (D pinout, description), p.2 (terminal functions), p.3 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V), p.6 (digital input timing, Figure 1), p.10 (power-on reset to zero, serial interface), p.11 (data format, register-select bits, DAC data bits D11-D4), p.12 (control register REF1/REF0, examples)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs (x2 buffer), reference REF and the internal reference selected by REF1/REF0 (stored only); SPD (settling) and PWR (power down) affect the analog side only (stored in CTRL)
a frame cut short by CS rising before 16 bits (the datasheet moves the partial shift register to the latches) is discarded
the extra SCLK rising edge after D0 that resets the internal state machine (p.10) is not needed by the model
DAC A has no double buffer: its input and DAC register are the same latch (dac lists LATCHA twice)
the terminal table lists OUTA as I; it is the DAC A output (role output)
variants: tlv5626.pdf covers only the TLV5626 (C and I grades); TLV5637 (10-bit) and TLV5638 (12-bit) share the interface and control register.
